## Load libraries

```{r}
#| warning: false

library(dplyr)
```

## Info on national parks

```{r}
# Load a dataset of the top 5 national parks by visits
np_top_5_df <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/melaniewalsh/Neat-Datasets/refs/heads/main/2020-National-Park-Visits-By-State-Top5.csv")

number_parks_in_dataset <- 
  np_top_5_df |> 
  nrow()

avg_visitors <- 
  np_top_5_df |> 
  pull(RecreationVisits) |>
  mean() |>
  round()

```

In this dataset, we have `r number_parks_in_dataset` National Parks. The average number of visits per park is `r avg_visitors`.
